body.name: \mathcal M_n
body.construction:
\[
\mathcal M_n(\kappa,r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en};c_-,c_+,\lambda_0,\eta_+,\sigma_0^2,\sigma_1^2,M,\bar r)
=\Bigl\{(P,m_0,m_1,p):(r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\in[0,\bar r]^3
\text{ and, at sample size }n,\ \texttt{ass:iid},\ \texttt{ass:consistency},
\ \texttt{ass:ignorability},\ \texttt{ass:positivity},\ \texttt{ass:uniform-shell},
\ \texttt{ass:right-overlap},\ \texttt{ass:treated-residual-variance},
\ \texttt{ass:control-residual-variance},\ \texttt{ass:bounded-treatment-effect-signal},
\ \texttt{ass:public-g0-radius},\ \texttt{ass:public-g1-radius},
\ \texttt{ass:public-e-radius},\ \texttt{ass:lower-shell-richness},
\text{ and }\texttt{ass:upper-shell-richness}\text{ hold}\Bigr\}.
\]
